name: shaman
description: a Shaman (Fall from Heaven), a hunched tribal spirit-caller: his face hidden under a bleached horned animal-skull mask with a glowing orange eye, a shaggy grey-brown fur hood and mane, a layered ragged hide-and-fur robe, a necklace of bone fangs and blue beads, a hide pouch at his screen-left hip, brown boots, a few orange embers drifting by the mask, and a crooked wooden totem staff topped with a horned animal skull, blue beads and a white feather in his LEFT hand
hands: the skull-topped totem staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist resting on top of the hide pouch at his hip on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the skull-masked head snaps back toward the upper-left, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left, the skull-topped totem staff thrown up and out in his left hand), the fur hood and robe jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the totem staff tilting back, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the skull-topped totem staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the skull-masked head droops, the totem staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the skull end of the totem staff resting on the ground, his empty right hand hanging by the hide pouch
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the totem staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the fur robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the skull mask facing up; the totem staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the shaggy fur hood spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the fur hood and robe settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the eye of the skull mask gone dark, the totem staff on the ground beside him
